source_en: Morning, Officer. Forgive the [[infected:cough]]. Dust from the lower road.
I used to write stories, you know. Now I carry other people's.
They burned the day of the blast. Twenty years of pages, gone.
I didn't like where my story was going. So I picked up the satchel.
Lately I find words in my head that aren't mine. Whole sentences.
Directions, mostly. To a road my feet already seem to know.
The doctor coughs worse than I do.
Keep your water boiled, Officer. I'd hate to lose my best reader.
